title: AwesomeCUA: newly reviewed resources

items.title: kev-0.6b-browser-use
items.content_text: kev-0.6b-browser-use is a 0.6B browser decision model that scores candidate page elements and chooses a click, type, or select operation from a task goal.
items.summary: kev-0.6b-browser-use is a 0.6B browser decision model that scores candidate page elements and chooses a click, type, or select operation from a task goal.

items.title: OpenJev-Data
items.content_text: OpenJev-Data provides labeled browser steps for training models to choose a web agent's next operation and target element, plus a fixed test set for endpoint evaluation.
items.summary: OpenJev-Data provides labeled browser steps for training models to choose a web agent's next operation and target element, plus a fixed test set for endpoint evaluation.

items.title: Programming with Pixels (PwP)
items.content_text: Programming with Pixels provides a framework and benchmark for software-engineering agents that work in IDEs through screenshots, typing, and clicks.
items.summary: Programming with Pixels provides a framework and benchmark for software-engineering agents that work in IDEs through screenshots, typing, and clicks.

items.title: rebrowser-patches
items.content_text: rebrowser-patches modifies Puppeteer and Playwright to reduce browser automation signals, and provides drop-in packages for both libraries.
items.summary: rebrowser-patches modifies Puppeteer and Playwright to reduce browser automation signals, and provides drop-in packages for both libraries.

items.title: James4Ever0/the_frozen_forest
items.content_text: A dataset archive of screen recordings paired with keyboard and mouse events. Timestamp files align video frames with recorded input actions.
items.summary: A dataset archive of screen recordings paired with keyboard and mouse events. Timestamp files align video frames with recorded input actions.

items.title: ydotool
items.content_text: ydotool is a Linux command-line utility for sending mouse and keyboard input. It provides commands to click, move the pointer, type text and press keys.
items.summary: ydotool is a Linux command-line utility for sending mouse and keyboard input. It provides commands to click, move the pointer, type text and press keys.

items.title: aside-telegram-bridge
items.content_text: A Telegram bridge and phone Mini App for sending tasks to the Aside browser agent, viewing live progress and transcripts, and responding to its decisions.
items.summary: A Telegram bridge and phone Mini App for sending tasks to the Aside browser agent, viewing live progress and transcripts, and responding to its decisions.

items.title: Google Developer Codelab: Automated UI Testing with Antigravity (Agy) CLI, BrowserMCP, Playwright, and the Browser Agent
items.content_text: A hands-on codelab for creating browser-based UI tests with Antigravity CLI, BrowserMCP and a Playwright agent skill, using an included demo application.
items.summary: A hands-on codelab for creating browser-based UI tests with Antigravity CLI, BrowserMCP and a Playwright agent skill, using an included demo application.
